question.text: Annexure 3 Row 16 requires disclosure of 'Social Intent of the NPO (Specify the Sub-clause(s) of Regulation ___ of ICDR Regulations along with Clarifications)'. What is the correct Regulation and sub-clause reference?

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Annexure 3 Row 16 literally reads: 'Social Intent of the NPO (Specify the Sub-clause(s) of Regulation 292E (2)(a) of ICDR Regulations along with Clarifications).' Regulation 292E lists the 16 eligible activities / social intents. The NPO picks the applicable sub-clause(s) and explains alignment. **The Trap:** 292A is the overall SSE chapter opener. Reg 33 is LODR financial-results disclosure. Section 135 is Companies Act CSR — not an ICDR Reg. The SIA must know exact reg numbers — candidates often confuse 292A (definition), 292B (activities), 292D (on-boarding), 292E (eligibility), 292F (registration criteria). **Cross-Exam Context:** III-A/III-C and XV touch ICDR broadly. Reg 292-series is SSE-specific (XXIII exclusive). **Assessor's Pro-Tip:** In the assurance engagement acceptance form, identify the exact 292E(2)(a) sub-clauses claimed by the NPO and map each to a primary activity and evidence source. If the NPO claims multiple sub-clauses, apportion revenue/expenditure to each — the 67% test may need to be satisfied on the primary sub-clause.
